hypothesis: Allow layer3 as well as layer4/head to adapt, with smaller layer3 LR 1e-5 and fixed BatchNorm. Eight-epoch allowance reflects compute cost; compare the complete configuration, not an isolated capacity effect.
test_policy: Use original train for updates and original val for checkpoint selection; never load original test. No external sUAS data in training or selection.
budget_note: Requested one-hour window; 780-second cap checked between epochs, plus an external guard and documentation reserve.
stopping_rule: At most 8 epochs, four non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 780 seconds checked between epochs; an external guard protects the overall hour deadline.
historical_selection_note: Learning rates were previously selected in the tracked development report. This run reproduces those settings; it does not rerun or independently revalidate the historical CV evidence.
